bio: Set in the heart of the old town, Hendrik (Henne) Olfen's appealing bistro-style restaurant has a pleasantly laid-back atmosphere – and it's really popular! Likewise, the excellent food, which represents great value for money, goes down just as well! There is a simple menu at lunchtime and, in the evening, a range of modern, seasonal tapas-style plates that are ideal for sharing. Decent wine list. Delightful little courtyard terrace....
